text: No, the method did not find any tree-cover loss event on this property after 2020. The analysis used Hansen Global Forest Change data (through 2025) and the JRC 2020 forest baseline as corroboration. While the asset had 91.77% forest cover in 2020 (per JRC), no subsequent loss events meeting the 0.5-hectare minimum threshold were detected in the annual series. The latest data (2025) confirms no changes post-2020.
